name: Generate branded AI images with OpenAI and post them to social media via PostFast

parameters.content:
## Generate branded AI images with OpenAI and post them to social media via PostFast

### How it works

Runs Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings. Loads your brand settings, retrieves connected PostFast accounts, filters the target platforms, asks OpenAI for a caption plus an image prompt, renders the image with gpt-image-1, then uploads one copy per selected account through pre-signed S3 URLs and schedules each account's post with its own media key.

### Setup steps

- Install the verified PostFast community node (n8n Cloud: enable Verified Community Nodes in the Admin Panel; self-hosted: install n8n-nodes-postfast).
- Connect your PostFast credentials (API key from Settings > API) on the three PostFast nodes.
- Connect OpenAI credentials on both OpenAI nodes.
- Update Set Brand and Style: brand name, image style, topics, target platforms.
- Run once manually and review the scheduled posts in your PostFast dashboard before activating.

### Customization

Adjust the image style, topics, posting days, image size or platform filter. Up to 8 accounts per run (the upload endpoint issues at most 8 image URLs per request).

## Start and configure

Triggers three times a week and sets the brand, style, topics and platform filter for the run.

## Fetch target accounts

Gets connected PostFast accounts and keeps the platforms you selected.

## Create the visual

OpenAI writes the caption and image prompt, PostFast issues one pre-signed upload URL per account, then gpt-image-1 renders the image.

## Upload and schedule

The image is uploaded once per account (each PUT sends a matching Content-Type header), then every account gets its own scheduled post with its own media key, one hour ahead.
